g.text: Proteins predicted uniformly with pyrodigal; orthologue clusters built by all-vs-all BLASTP (>=60% identity, >=60% query coverage) and connected components (3243 clusters total).
Comparison panel includes the strains used in the reference-style comparison (IDCC 2105, CX 2-6_2).
